sourceTitle: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
originalTitle: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT‑6.1 Sol
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: DevRev built Computer and Operator to help service and operations teams carry even the hardest customer and employee requests through to completion. Computer and Operator are designed to reason across live data. Actions are reversible, and answers point back to their sources, explains Ahmed Bashir, DevRev’s chief technology officer.
blocks.en: DevRev built Computer and Operator to help service and operations teams carry even the hardest customer and employee requests through to completion. Computer and Operator are designed to reason across live data. Actions are reversible, and answers point back to their sources, explains Ahmed Bashir, DevRev’s chief technology officer.
blocks.zh: DevRev 打造了 Computer 和 Operator ，帮助服务与运营团队全程跟进并处理客户和员工的请求，即使是最棘手的请求也不例外。Computer 和 Operator 能够整合实时数据进行推理。DevRev 首席技术官 Ahmed Bashir 解释说，操作可以撤销，答案也能追溯到来源。

blocks.text: DevRev combines OpenAI models, including GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑6.1 Sol, with its harness for connecting company knowledge and giving teams control over the actions an agent can take. DevRev sees OpenAI models as providing reasoning and reliability with the speed and cost of serving customers and employees.
blocks.en: DevRev combines OpenAI models, including GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑6.1 Sol, with its harness for connecting company knowledge and giving teams control over the actions an agent can take. DevRev sees OpenAI models as providing reasoning and reliability with the speed and cost of serving customers and employees.
blocks.zh: DevRev 将 GPT‑6 Astra 和 GPT‑6.1 Sol 等 OpenAI 模型与自身的执行框架相结合，接入企业知识，并让团队能够管控智能体可执行的操作。在 DevRev 看来，OpenAI 模型既具备推理能力和可靠性，也能满足为客户和员工提供服务时对速度与成本的要求。

blocks.text: “It’s a combination of being able to have the right reasoning capabilities, being able to be trusted, highly aligned, and most importantly, it has to work from a latency perspective.”
blocks.en: “It’s a combination of being able to have the right reasoning capabilities, being able to be trusted, highly aligned, and most importantly, it has to work from a latency perspective.”
blocks.zh: “它需要兼具恰当的推理能力、可信赖性和高度对齐性，而最重要的是，响应延迟必须满足实际需求。”

blocks.text: Making AI work with company context
blocks.en: Making AI work with company context
blocks.zh: 让 AI 结合企业背景信息开展工作

blocks.text: OpenAI models power the reasoning, planning, and tool selection behind both Computer and Operator. In DevRev’s Agent Studio, users can describe how they want a tool to behave in a conversation with AI and define parts of its behavior with fixed rules.
blocks.en: OpenAI models power the reasoning, planning, and tool selection behind both Computer and Operator. In DevRev’s Agent Studio, users can describe how they want a tool to behave in a conversation with AI and define parts of its behavior with fixed rules.
blocks.zh: Computer 和 Operator 的推理、规划及工具选择能力均由 OpenAI 模型驱动。在 DevRev 的 Agent Studio 中，用户可以通过与 AI 对话来描述期望工具如何运作，也可以用固定规则定义工具的部分行为。

blocks.text: DevRev tests the models together with the software that supplies company context, enforces permissions, and controls actions. Its Enterprise-Bench benchmark evaluates how well they work when data has multiple versions, information sits in different systems, and access depends on a person’s role.
blocks.en: DevRev tests the models together with the software that supplies company context, enforces permissions, and controls actions. Its Enterprise-Bench benchmark evaluates how well they work when data has multiple versions, information sits in different systems, and access depends on a person’s role.
blocks.zh: DevRev 将模型与配套软件一起测试，这些软件负责提供企业背景信息、实施权限管理并管控操作。其 Enterprise-Bench 基准测试用于评估模型与软件在以下情境中的协同表现：数据存在多个版本、信息分散在不同系统中，以及访问权限取决于用户角色。

blocks.text: Ahmed says GPT‑6.1 Sol performs well in those evaluations. When a customer or employee is interacting with an AI agent, the model needs to understand the nuances of the request and respond quickly, at a cost the business can sustain. “I think it strikes the balance perfectly,” Ahmed says.
blocks.en: Ahmed says GPT‑6.1 Sol performs well in those evaluations. When a customer or employee is interacting with an AI agent, the model needs to understand the nuances of the request and respond quickly, at a cost the business can sustain. “I think it strikes the balance perfectly,” Ahmed says.
blocks.zh: Ahmed 表示，GPT‑6.1 Sol 在这些评估中表现出色。当客户或员工与 AI 智能体交互时，模型需要理解请求中的细微差别，并以企业可持续承担的成本快速响应。Ahmed 说：“我认为它在这些方面实现了完美的平衡。”

blocks.text: Building software and sales demos with Codex
blocks.en: Building software and sales demos with Codex
blocks.zh: 使用 Codex 开发软件和制作销售演示

blocks.text: Inside DevRev, engineers have made a clear choice about the best way to build. “Our entire team uses Codex,” Ahmed says. The adoption grew organically after engineers explored multiple coding tools. By the time of the interview, DevRev had moved fully to Codex and dropped its Cursor licenses.
blocks.en: Inside DevRev, engineers have made a clear choice about the best way to build. “Our entire team uses Codex,” Ahmed says. The adoption grew organically after engineers explored multiple coding tools. By the time of the interview, DevRev had moved fully to Codex and dropped its Cursor licenses.
blocks.zh: 在 DevRev 内部，工程师们对最佳开发方式已有明确的选择。Ahmed 说：“我们整个团队都在使用 Codex。”工程师们尝试了多种编程工具后，便开始在团队中自发推广 Codex。截至访谈时，DevRev 已全面转向 Codex，不再订阅 Cursor 许可证。

blocks.text: For Ahmed, this reflects what developers value: “Developers are really just looking for the best tool, and you can’t fool them.” His engineers were unequivocal about wanting to continue with Codex.
blocks.en: For Ahmed, this reflects what developers value: “Developers are really just looking for the best tool, and you can’t fool them.” His engineers were unequivocal about wanting to continue with Codex.
blocks.zh: 在 Ahmed 看来，这反映了开发者真正看重的东西：“开发者其实就是在寻找最好的工具，你骗不了他们。”他手下的工程师都明确表示，希望继续使用 Codex。

blocks.text: “We think that Codex is far and away the best experience.”
blocks.en: “We think that Codex is far and away the best experience.”
blocks.zh: “我们认为，Codex 的使用体验无疑是最好的，远超其他工具。”

blocks.text: DevRev’s sales engineers also use GPT‑6 Astra to create demos for the company’s booths at international conferences.
blocks.en: DevRev’s sales engineers also use GPT‑6 Astra to create demos for the company’s booths at international conferences.
blocks.zh: DevRev 的销售工程师也使用 GPT‑6 Astra 为公司在国际会议上的展台制作演示。

blocks.text: Responding faster to customers and employees
blocks.en: Responding faster to customers and employees
blocks.zh: 更快响应客户和员工的需求

blocks.text: When a customer or employee asks for help, the request may require Operator to understand the issue, take approved action, or route to Computer to prepare the right person to act. Ahmed sees opportunities for the Decisions API and Ultrafast to help those workflows finish quickly, without requiring deep reasoning at every step.
blocks.en: When a customer or employee asks for help, the request may require Operator to understand the issue, take approved action, or route to Computer to prepare the right person to act. Ahmed sees opportunities for the Decisions API and Ultrafast to help those workflows finish quickly, without requiring deep reasoning at every step.
blocks.zh: 当客户或员工寻求帮助时，Operator 可能需要理解问题、执行获准操作，或将请求转交给 Computer，由它帮助合适的人员做好准备以便采取相应行动。Ahmed 认为，Decisions API 和 Ultrafast 有望帮助这些工作流快速完成，而不必在每一步都进行深度推理。

blocks.text: Some of those decisions are difficult and expensive to define with fixed rules, especially when the information they depend on keeps changing. Ahmed wants builders to be able to describe more of that logic conversationally and choose the right kind of intelligence for each task. “These things have to be able to run and complete themselves in seconds, not minutes,” he says.
blocks.en: Some of those decisions are difficult and expensive to define with fixed rules, especially when the information they depend on keeps changing. Ahmed wants builders to be able to describe more of that logic conversationally and choose the right kind of intelligence for each task. “These things have to be able to run and complete themselves in seconds, not minutes,” he says.
blocks.zh: 其中一些决策很难用固定规则定义，成本也很高，尤其是当决策所依赖的信息持续变化时。Ahmed 希望开发者能通过对话描述更多这类逻辑，并为每项任务选择合适的智能能力。他说：“这些流程必须能够在几秒内自行运行并完成，而不是几分钟。”

blocks.text: DevRev’s next ambition is for Operator to take on longer, more demanding customer and employee requests while keeping actions traceable, permissioned, and reversible.
blocks.en: DevRev’s next ambition is for Operator to take on longer, more demanding customer and employee requests while keeping actions traceable, permissioned, and reversible.
blocks.zh: DevRev 的下一个目标是让 Operator 承担流程更长、要求更高的客户和员工请求，同时确保操作可追溯、受权限管控且可撤销。

blocks.text: Ahmed sees familiar support tasks, such as finding a knowledge-base answer, upgrading a plan, or getting a refund, as only the beginning. “We want to really realize that promise of self-service,” he says.
blocks.en: Ahmed sees familiar support tasks, such as finding a knowledge-base answer, upgrading a plan, or getting a refund, as only the beginning. “We want to really realize that promise of self-service,” he says.
blocks.zh: 在 Ahmed 看来，从知识库中查找答案、升级套餐或申请退款等常见支持任务，仅仅是个开始。他说：“我们希望真正兑现自助服务的承诺。”

blocks.text: With OpenAI’s frontier intelligence, DevRev is building toward Computer and Operator carrying more complex requests through to resolution, with the company knowledge and controls to act on a person’s behalf.
blocks.en: With OpenAI’s frontier intelligence, DevRev is building toward Computer and Operator carrying more complex requests through to resolution, with the company knowledge and controls to act on a person’s behalf.
blocks.zh: 借助 OpenAI 的前沿智能能力，DevRev 正致力于让 Computer 和 Operator 依托企业知识和管控机制，代表用户执行操作，全程跟进并处理更复杂的请求。
